autostart_policy: Techscope Web and Telegram bot may run as launchd services from TECHSCOPE_ROOT after explicit approval. New agents must not inherit this automatically.
start_command: launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.techscope.web.plist && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.techscope.telegram-bot.plist
stop_command: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.techscope.web; launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.techscope.telegram-bot

proactivity.trigger_sources: Telegram getUpdates polling, manual Codex thread work, local scripts
proactivity.idle_behavior: Stay resident as launchd service; process queued intake only when messages arrive.
proactivity.user_interruption_policy: User can stop launchd services or ask Codex to pause work.
